AnswerQuestionParams.description:
Parameters of `answer_question`: the person's choice.

For now the eval sends the answer, signed with the eval's token, and the sidecar accepts it only for a question from one of that eval's own runs. So any client that holds the eval's token can answer that eval's questions. Later, reviewers will answer with credentials of their own, which the sidecar will check.

Unlike the `mac` of other calls, it covers the answer, so a `mac` copied from one answer cannot sign a different answer.
mac.title: Mac

decision.description: The person's choice, one of the question's `choices`.
decision.title: Decision

reason.description: The person's reason, if they gave one. For `reject`, the sidecar tells the model this reason.

CancelPausedRequestParams.description:
Parameters of `cancel_paused_request`: cancels a request paused for a person, which the eval has given up on.

The sidecar closes the request in whatever state it is, with nothing decided. It stops the judging and closes the request's questions. It lets no further try through to the provider. If a try is already with the provider, the sidecar does not judge, keep or pass on its reply. `request_result` then answers `not_judged` with the reason `cancelled`, and the request cannot be resumed.

eval_id.description: The eval's id, as its requests name it.
eval_id.title: Eval Id

timestamp.description: When the caller signed, in whole seconds since the epoch. A call whose timestamp is further from the sidecar's clock than its window, five minutes by default, is refused with `unauthorized`.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

mac.description: An HMAC-SHA256, in hex, made with the eval's token over `json.dumps([str(v) for v in [method, eval_id, timestamp]], separators=(",", ":"))`, such as `["sample_result","eval_789","1794182400"]`. It proves only that the caller holds the token, not the call's other parameters. A call whose `mac` isn't made with the token the sidecar keeps for the eval is refused with `unauthorized`. A sidecar that keeps no token for the eval, as after a restart, holds nothing of it for anyone.
mac.title: Mac

A second `cancel_paused_request` for the same request also answers false. So false does not mean the request is still paused: call `request_result` for its state.
cancelled.title: Cancelled

failure.description: The provider's most recent failure. Present with `awaiting_resend` and a `reason`.

For a request paused for a person, it is the total over the request's tries, and each try counts only while its client was waiting on it. 0 where nothing was judged. Sent with `judging_usage` on every answer about records the sidecar holds, whether or not the judgment is trimmed.

judging_usage.description: What the provider billed for each model the sentinel called while judging every attempt at the request, retried attempts included, since each was billed. Sent with `judging_time` on every answer about records the sidecar holds, whether or not the judgment is trimmed.

title: Inspect Sentinel: the endpoint for evals
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 methods, POSTed to /sentinel/v1, with a probe at GET /sentinel/info. A POST of a paused call's model request to /sentinel/v1/judged-reply is not a method: it fetches the provider's reply that the sidecar holds for that call, in the provider's format. `methods` names the definitions that a method's `params` and `result` fit. `errors` lists the codes of the method errors of the endpoint's own.

-32001.name: registration_refused
-32001.description: The sidecar takes no tasks registered by an eval, and this task was not registered beforehand; or, for `complete_registration`, the sidecar takes only the samples a task's registration names, and this sample isn't one.

-32008.name: registrations_full
-32008.description: The sidecar keeps as many task registrations as it takes, and takes another once a kept one expires; or, for `complete_registration`, the task's registration holds as much as the sidecar takes for a task. A failure, not a refusal: the deployment has not said that the task may not run.

-32002.name: unknown_sample
-32002.description: The sidecar holds nothing for the sample, so an eval never mistakes a forgotten sample for a clean one.

-32009.name: unknown_task
-32009.description: The sidecar holds no registration of the task by the eval: it was never registered, or is no longer kept. The eval registers the task again, then completes the sample's registration. Answered to a `register_task` with a `mac` when the sidecar holds no token for the eval, as after a restart or once the token expired: the eval registers again with its token.

-32011.name: unknown_question
-32011.description: The sidecar holds no such question for the eval. Either the question was never asked, or it belongs to another eval. Or it closed without an answer: it expired and the sidecar gave the sentinel the cautious answer, or its model call was closed first, for example because the eval cancelled the call or ended the sample. Or it was answered, and the sidecar no longer keeps the record of that answer, for example after the eval ended the sample.

-32012.name: question_answered
-32012.description: The question already has an answer with a different choice or reason. The sidecar keeps the first answer.

-32013.name: answer_refused
-32013.description: The answer's choice is not one the question offers.

-32010.name: unauthorized
-32010.description: The call's `mac` isn't made with the token the sidecar keeps for the eval, or its `timestamp` is further from the sidecar's clock than the window allows; or a `register_task` sent another token than the one the sidecar keeps for the eval.
